ota_transfer_speed.root_cause: low-power OTA was slow because OTA begin active-link recovery happened after the measured transfer path and installed Type background heartbeat could contend for BLE; Type now holds a Windows named OTA mutex, sends TYPE:OTA before the transfer timer, and firmware requests active BLE connection parameters from that command.
